description: Export the cards of up to 20 detections (request_id of recognize_cards or recognize_folder, within 48 hours) as the same file the NeoSatoshi website exports, built by the website's own export code: your account's condition for new cards, corrections made with correct_card, your saved settings, price rules and templates. Formats: csv/json (custom export; preset = a saved preset id from list_export_presets, or fields and json_mode "api"/"custom"), tcgpowertools (the TCGPowerTools CSV for Cardmarket), shopify (the Shopify product CSV, prices in the store currency) and ebay (the eBay Seller Hub CSV for one eBay site). Price options for tcgpowertools, shopify and ebay, like the buttons of the website's pricing step: price_source, min_price, markup_percent and rounding (a markup or rounding replaces your saved price rules; 0 = no markup). tcgpowertools: comment. shopify: store_currency, variant_mode. ebay: marketplace, one_row_per_card. Cards that cannot be exported are named in the answer, never guessed. Free (no credits). Needs your own API key (demo detections keep no cards) and exports enabled for the account. Football detections cannot be exported yet. save_to_folder writes the file into a local folder (allowed by NEOSATOSHI_ALLOWED_DIRS, never overwrites); without it the file content comes back in the answer (up to 100 KB).

comment.description: tcgpowertools: the Cardmarket comment for every row (default: the one saved on the website).

fields.description: Field ids in column order (list_export_presets). Default: the recommended columns.

json_mode.description: JSON only: api = the documented card shape (fields ignored), custom = your fields. Default api.

marketplace.description: ebay: the eBay site, e.g. EBAY_DE, EBAY_US, EBAY_GB (default: your saved one).

markup_percent.description: tcgpowertools, shopify, ebay: markup in percent from the market price; replaces the saved price rules. 0 = no markup.

min_price.description: tcgpowertools, shopify, ebay: a floor for every row (EUR, the store currency, or the eBay site's currency).

one_row_per_card.description: ebay: one CSV row per copy instead of one row with a quantity.

preset.description: Id of a saved export preset (list_export_presets). Not together with format, fields or json_mode.

price_source.description: tcgpowertools, shopify, ebay: the market price to start from. Default cardmarket_30d (tcgplayer not for tcgpowertools).

request_ids.description: request_id of each detection to export, in the order the rows should have.

rounding.description: tcgpowertools, shopify, ebay: round every price; replaces the saved price rules.

save_to_folder.description: Local folder to write the file into (~ is expanded). Existing files are never overwritten.

store_currency.description: shopify: your Shopify store's currency, e.g. EUR (default: read from your connected store).

variant_mode.description: shopify: one product per card with variants, or one product per language, condition and printing (default: your saved choice).

name: export_cards
title: Export detected cards as CSV or JSON
